probes.check: After the world is gone, the facade's probe-build block tracking shows flecs released no block the facade didn't allocate; one it did fails the rule as ALLOC_HOOK_LATE(flecs).

seeded_violation.description: Allocate a block with flecs's default allocator before setting the facade's, then free it through the facade's.

probes.check: am_probe_flecs_allocation(): the installed OS API has the facade's malloc_ and free_, and the facade served flecs during the run.

seeded_violation.description: Leave flecs's default allocation functions in the OS API.

adaptation_notes: flecs reads malloc_, calloc_, realloc_ and free_ from its OS API table: the binding sets them in the table setup glue installs with ecs_os_set_api before ecs_init, so the world never allocates without them.
flecs asks for no particular alignment; calloc_ maps to the facade's zeroed allocation.
